english.title: Permit nuisance / disturbance on school / academy premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority, were present on premises of

(A)_[a school maintained by the **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL EDUCATION AUTHORITY..),]_
(B)_[a grant-maintained school,]_
(C)_[an Academy that is not an independent school,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), and permitted a nuisance or disturbance to the annoyance of persons who lawfully used those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 547(1) of the Education Act 1996.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority
were present on
premises of local authority maintained/grant-maintained school/an Academy that is not and independent school
and permitted a nuisance/disturbance
to the annoyance of persons lawfully using those premises

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See the similar offence of nuisance/disturbance on higher educational premises.

other.powersofarrest:
A police constable or a person so authorised by the local authority has reasonable cause to suspect that any person is committing or has committed an offence under this section, he may remove him from the premises. (section 547(3)).

Arrest without warrant
other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
